{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the data is loaded correctly
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Drop rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data sentinel)
df_clean = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = df_clean['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age (excluding -1 values): {mean_age}")"}
